question: What mistake did Elena Verna make when she was tasked with building a community at Nero, and what helped her change direction?
expected_points: She tried to figure out community-building from scratch and focused only on users.
She sought advice from people with community-building experience, who helped her consider agency or partner communities first.
evidence_quote: I was approaching it almost like a finding product market fit, and I will fail so much doing it.
